# tragedy-slicer-core — the engine behind the tragedy-labs slicer, as plain functions
# over PrusaSlicer's own code (ADR 0032 in the tragedy-labs monorepo).
#
# One static library, hosted twice: by tragedy-slicer-service (native, HTTP and
# WebSocket) today and by a WebAssembly host later. It knows nothing about sockets.
# It speaks the message types in include/tragedy/slicer/Messages.hpp, which are
# GENERATED by the monorepo's contracts (contracts/scripts/generate-slicer.py) and
# checked against them before every build; edit the schemas there, never the header.
#
# It links slic3r-app-cli because the CLI's runtime (CLIRuntime: the workbench, the
# project interactor, the preset bundle loaded the standard way) is exactly the
# engine without a window, and the CLI's own transform helpers centre a model on
# the bed the way the desktop app does.

add_library(tragedy-slicer-core STATIC
    src/Engine.cpp
    include/tragedy/slicer/Engine.hpp
    include/tragedy/slicer/Messages.hpp
)

target_include_directories(tragedy-slicer-core PUBLIC include)

find_package(nlohmann_json 3.11 REQUIRED)
find_package(magic_enum REQUIRED)

target_link_libraries(tragedy-slicer-core PUBLIC
    slic3r-app-cli
    nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json
    magic_enum::magic_enum
)

# Which fork commit this is built from, reported by GET /health so the shell can
# compare it with the one the contracts were generated from. Configure-time: a
# commit without a reconfigure reports the previous hash (build-engine.sh always
# reconfigures).
execute_process(
    COMMAND git rev-parse HEAD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE TRAGEDY_SLICER_COMMIT
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    ERROR_QUIET
)
if (NOT TRAGEDY_SLICER_COMMIT)
    set(TRAGEDY_SLICER_COMMIT "unknown")
endif ()
target_compile_definitions(tragedy-slicer-core PRIVATE
    TRAGEDY_SLICER_COMMIT="${TRAGEDY_SLICER_COMMIT}"
    TRAGEDY_SLICER_RESOURCES_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources"
)
